actionable_steps.citation: Be Ever Grateful To God — SSS Vol 29 (1996), 1996-08-17
actionable_steps.step: When you sing, let the bhajan come from a heart full of love — immerse yourself totally instead of performing for pitch or applause.

actionable_steps.citation: Glorify the Lord's Name — SSS Vol 19 (1986), 1986-11-08
actionable_steps.step: In group singing, choose familiar tunes everyone can follow, and keep the accent on the Name itself.

actionable_steps.citation: Sing the sweet name — SSS Vol 8 (1968), 1968-05-18
actionable_steps.step: Make bhajan as essential as breathing — a constant companion through the day, not just a Thursday habit.

actionable_steps.citation: Remembrance of the Lord's Name — SSS Vol 41 (2008), 2008-05-24
actionable_steps.step: Join nagara sankeertan in the early morning when you can; hearing the Divine Name at dawn fills the heart with bliss.

actionable_steps.citation: Revere Your Mother And Father As God — SSS Vol 41 (2008), 2008-01-15
actionable_steps.step: Whatever else slips in a busy day, never forget remembrance of the Name (namasmarana) and singing the Name (nama sankirtana).

definition.quote: Bhajan is the process of singing your prayers to God, praising His glory and compassion, and pleading that He may fill you with His Grace.

discourses.citation: The Insentient And The Supreme Consciousness — SSS Vol 1 (1953 - 60), 1959-07-10
discourses.quote: Akhanda means uninterrupted, without any gap... bhajans has to start in childhood and has to continue. It must be the constant companion of a person, their solace and strength.

discourses.citation: Chant the Name : sing His glory — SSS Vol 27 (1994), 1994-10-23
discourses.quote: What bliss is there in bhajans! What a demonstration of oneness is it when a myriad throats join in uttering the name of God!

discourses.citation: Put Ceiling On Your Desires — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-03-14
discourses.quote: Bhajan singing makes the heart sacred. What is important is that it should come out from the heart. Bhajan is not just rhythm, tune and beat. You should sing God's name with love.
Let your whole life be a bhajan. Believe that God is everywhere at all times, and derive strength, comfort and joy by singing His Glory in His Presence.

make_it_real: Today, let your whole life be a bhajan — sing His name, and mean every word.
title: Bhajans & Kirtan

vahinis.quote: At such times of mental pain, do repetition of the name (nama-smarana) for a while, sitting in a solitary place, or sing devotional songs (bhajans) loudly in a raised voice. If that isn't possible, spread the bed and sleep for some time.
